review_type: independent manual static fullbody reading-record review
acceptance_scope: Accept this distinct new paper reading record and its bounded interpretation only. Not experimental reproduction, candidate-code acceptance, runtime acceptance, production authorization, batch completion, or a reset of old gates.

paper.title: When Relevant Code Is Wrong: Runtime-Aware Context for AI Coding Agents

paper_text.coverage: Entire extracted text including abstract, I–VIII, every paragraph, Eq.1, all six Table I rows and four metrics, Figure 1 caption, Data Availability and all 20 reference entries; extraction chrome also present. No appendix is present in the available text.

actual_reading.author_documents: Read complete README (6707 bytes) and docs/metrics.md (3101 bytes).
actual_reading.html: SHA256/size verification and targeted local identity/ref14/figure-link inspection only; not full HTML DOM or image/PDF visual review.
actual_reading.project_instructions: Read entire AGENTS.md; hashed TASK.md and read relevant SYSTEM-99/CASE search excerpts only, not its entire 44491-character body.
actual_reading.not_read_or_executed: No author Java, raw CSV, labels, complete dataset, production code, model, network, tests, Maven, service or coding-agent run. Author commit/tree are pinned metadata from source.json; this reviewer did not independently query GitHub or revalidate the full Git tree.

scope.evidence: Exact ID, v1 date/title and arXiv identity match the local fullbody. Claimed 30496 characters, 100921 HTML bytes, 6707 README bytes and 3101 metrics bytes match static measurement. All eight supplied SHA256 references match. Fullbody coverage is accurately bounded to text/caption rather than PDF/image pixels.
scope.finding: No substitution of abstract-only reading, a previous paper, or source-code review.

method.evidence: Sections II–III / Eq.1 distinguish R(a,q) from V(a|d,t): authoritative non-conflicting timestamped evidence supporting a precondition is valid, supporting its negation invalid, otherwise unknown; missing traces do not prove invalidity. Versioned graph and artifact/implementation/flag/deployment/service nodes plus guards/deployed-in/calls/supersedes and provenance are faithfully summarized.
method.finding: Manual mappings/preconditions and cohort uncertainty remain explicit. Act On/Verify/Explain describes author context packaging, not a newly installed repository schema or execution permission.

results.evidence: Section IV / Table I values checked row-by-row: Semantic Only .50/1.00/16/5; Recency .43/.43/6/5; Semantic + Raw Cfg .50/1.00/16/5; CASE 1/1/0/0; w/o Flags .33/.13/0/0; w/o Lineage 1/1/0/0. P/R are unweighted task-level means; Inc/Unk are six-task actionable artifact occurrence totals. metrics.md specifies zero-actionable precision=0, preventing incorrect contradiction with no-flag mean precision .33.
results.finding: BM25 top-eight is lexical despite Semantic naming. Six tasks / 15 artifacts / three deployments are a synthetic deterministic context-selection fixture. Baseline raw-config parity is selection-metric parity and does not establish inability of an agent to infer configuration.

ablations.evidence: Sections IV–V / README: no flags makes formerly actionable artifacts uncertain and reduces recall to .13. No lineage has no change, since flags already decide fixture paths. Fixed-snapshot deployment replay changes US GraphQL Act On to EU REST.
ablations.finding: Record preserves the lineage negative result and does not claim independently demonstrated migration-lineage benefit, generalization, or downstream agent success.

limitations.evidence: Paper IV limitations and README explicitly say expert-curated relationships and same-rule hand-written oracle/reference labels, making perfect scores expected under the fixture. No independent real-world ground truth or downstream coding/patch/agent outcome measurement is provided. README states no bundled agent runs.
limitations.finding: Record correctly withholds correctness/quality/production efficacy/cost conclusions and identifies incomplete/conflicting configuration and maintenance/scaling uncertainty. Pinned author documents are not source-code conformance validation; prior-search partial/error caveat is retained rather than declaring historical absence.

repo_fit.evidence: reading.md adopts only applicability-review questions for existing result/knowledge/memory provenance and correction checks, retains historical failures/unknowns, and defers CASE graph, automatic configuration inference, three-section schema and major agent_doc migration pending real host/configuration scope and controlled final-quality evidence.
repo_fit.finding: The independent Codex installer bounded-read candidate is explicitly causally separate. No CASE speedup, closure of old Windows/FD/loading/concurrency issues, second writable task pool, or permission grant is inferred. This check reviews the reading record stated fit; it is not an audit of the current repository implementation.

resources.evidence: Author metrics defines tokens as characters/4 plus fixed 60-token header estimate; 1500 is approximate package budget. The record rejects treating this as provider tokenizer measurement, loaded input accounting or total system/model cost. Static-only scope and original 30-minute deadline / total two attempts are preserved.
resources.finding: No empirical compute or model budget spent. One completed review used; second attempt only for substantive required revision following this complete feedback, within original deadline. No unknown-feedback retry or budget reset.

optional_suggestions.suggestion: For any later source-code or reproduction task, independently re-pin the author commit/tree and inspect the relevant implementation/data; current acceptance deliberately relies only on the supplied pinned document metadata.

If a later deployment pilot is authorized, record actual loaded input/provider tokens, context construction and maintenance costs, independent labels, abstention/unknown handling and final patch compatibility under matched candidates/model/budget.
